name: Beetleweed
desc: Beetleweed (Galax urceolata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 129 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Galax, the wandplant, wandflower, or beetleweed, is a genus in the flowering plant family Diapensiaceae, containing a single species, Galax urceolata (syn. G. rotundifolia, G. aphylla).
